# Operation support evidence

<!-- Generated by tools/support_matrix.py --write; edit support-ledger.json. -->

This initial inventory records 7 bounded profiles, not complete format parity. All roadmap IDs remain visible below. Statuses cite historical installed-wheel evidence; validation of this file is not a new test run or a completion decision.

Ledger source-audit baseline: `5236ab12c9e136a8abbc675331370e6fbfd3ac99`. Historical tests do not certify this source revision. Native adapter/facade changes need their own behavioral review and release validation; matching fixture hashes are only a drift check.

Operations: **read** normalized content; **create** native-format serialization; **edit authored/imported** distinguish model provenance; **preserve** only named unchanged content; **render** PNG; **export** conversion to a named different format. Saving is not conversion.

Statuses: **verified** for the stated scope; **partial** with a stated gap; **unsupported** in the current facade; **blocked upstream** for a cited native constraint; **unassessed** without adequate evidence; **n/a** where the operation has no meaning.

The pinned SDK feature-family crosswalk remains in [API design](authoring-api-design.md). Complete SDK/PyMuPDF member dispositions remain separate unfinished work. No public capability-query API is introduced.

Maintain `docs/support-ledger.json`; run `python tools/support_matrix.py` to check and `python tools/support_matrix.py --write` to regenerate. A changed test-file digest requires review of its assertions/fixture provenance and relevant artifact evidence, not a blind hash refresh. Native citations were source-audited at their immutable pins; the offline checker validates their references, not native code execution or remote symbol existence.

## pdf.region

PNG rendering of a page-view rectangle; not content-stream clipping.

**Public paths:** `open(...).render_page(..., clip=...)`, `open(...)[0].get_pixmap(..., clip=...)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic small PDFs built in test_render_clipping.py with native authoring; explicit CropBox/Rotate/UserUnit dictionaries in the test exercise geometry. PNG samples are decoded by the local test helper, with narrow fixture-specific rounding tolerances. No third-party PDF corpus is implied.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |

| Preserve | **n/a** — This row evaluates region rendering, not document mutation, extraction or format conversion. |
| Render | **verified** — Display-space rectangles honor CropBox, rotations and UserUnit; finite/positive/intersection/resource checks. Tested tolerances are fixture-specific, not universal pixel identity. ## word.properties

Strict scalar custom properties, separate from core/extended metadata.

**Public paths:** `open(...).metadata["custom"]`, `new("docx").update_metadata(custom=...)`

**Fixture provenance:** Synthetic DOCX built by the public authoring API; test_imported_properties.py replaces the custom property ZIP part with explicit scalar, malformed, duplicate and oversized XML fixtures. Source patches are test-only, not a runtime parser/writer.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **partial** — lpwstr, bool, i8 and finite r8 only; 1024 entries / 64 KiB value / 256 KiB raw aggregate. ASCII-ambiguous names all omitted. ## word.table-alternative-text

## pdf.vertical-redaction

Secure removal of vertical-writing text beneath a redaction mark; no public package redaction API currently.

**Public paths:** None; this is an explicit gap.

**Fixture provenance:** No local package fixture because the operation is absent. Native source fixture crates/redact/src/tests.rs::vertical_writing_text_under_a_mark_fails_closed constructs the failure case; inspected at the pinned revision, not rerun by this ledger validation.

| Operation | Evidence and limits |
|---|---|
| Read | **n/a** — This profile concerns removal, not extraction of vertical text. |
| Create | **unsupported** — No current public redaction creation API. |
| Edit authored | **blocked upstream** — Native application explicitly fails closed for vertical-writing text; implementing the general removal guarantee requires upstream geometry work. [RedactError::VerticalText, apply](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/redact/src/lib.rs); [vertical_writing_text_under_a_mark_fails_closed](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/redact/src/tests.rs); [U10](../docs/upstream-roadmap.md) |
| Edit imported | **blocked upstream** — Same vertical-writing removal limitation; presence of the native redaction crate does not establish this operation. [RedactError::VerticalText, apply](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/redact/src/lib.rs); [vertical_writing_text_under_a_mark_fails_closed](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/blob/645016addcfb9078c557f0189559ab47cdcee057/crates/redact/src/tests.rs); [U10](../docs/upstream-roadmap.md) |
| Preserve | **unassessed** — No package redaction operation or preservation corpus exists for this profile. |
| Render | **n/a** — An opaque overlay is not evidence that underlying content was removed. |
| Export | **n/a** — A format conversion is not a secure-redaction guarantee. |
